title: The history box reads as a list of prompts
body:
The history box (`MenuTarget::History` in `draw_menu`, `ui.rs`) draws one row per earlier prompt: its first line cut to fit, with a dim `N lines` note right after it for a longer prompt. Every row starts at the same column with plain text and ends where its text ends. Jack found the box reads as one oddly formatted paragraph, not as separate items.

## Proposal

- Each row starts with a dim `›` marker.
- A right-aligned dim column shows the prompt's age, as in `now`, `5m`, `2h` or `3d`. The `N lines` note moves into the same column, before the age. `App::history` keeps each prompt's send time beside its text for this. A prompt from a resumed session has no time and shows no age.
- Every other row is shaded with the palette's `tint`. The highlighted row keeps the `selection` background.

## Rejected

- A rule between entries. It halves the prompts that fit in 10 rows.
- A preview of the highlighted prompt in full under the list. It can come later if long prompts turn out hard to pick.
close_reason: Landed in f468b53. History rows start with a dim marker. A right-hand dim column holds the line count and the age, and every other row is shaded with the tint. `App::history` holds each text with an `Option<Time>`, and `Time::age` gives the age.
